Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_Tier1Range_to: Max wireless distance when the network has a Tier 1 (base) WiFi Antenna installed. Any tablet works at this range - the ANTENNA'S tier decides the distance, not which tablet you carry.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_Tier2Range_to: Max wireless distance when the network has a Tier 2 (upgraded) WiFi Antenna installed. Any tablet works at this range - the ANTENNA'S tier decides the distance, not which tablet you carry.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_Tier3Range_to: Max wireless distance when the network has a Tier 3 (top) WiFi Antenna installed. Any tablet works at this range - the ANTENNA'S tier decides the distance, not which tablet you carry.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaWe: Chance to find a fully assembled WiFi Antenna peripheral. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaDi: Chance to find a loose Antenna Dish part. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaTr: Chance to find a loose Antenna Transmitter part. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletWei: Chance to find a fully assembled base Tablet (tier 1). 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletScr: Chance to find a loose Tablet Screen part. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletBat: Chance to find a loose Tablet Battery part. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletCra: Chance to find a fully assembled Craft Tablet (tier 2). 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find a loose Craft Tablet Module. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletBui: Chance to find a fully assembled Builder Tablet (tier 2). 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find a loose Builder Tablet Module. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootTabletMas: Chance to find a fully assembled Master Tablet (tier 3, very rare by default). 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find a loose Master Tablet Core. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootManualAnt: Chance to find the magazine that teaches the WiFi Antenna and its parts. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootManualTab: Chance to find the magazine that teaches the base Tablet and its parts. 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find the magazine that teaches the Craft Tablet and its module. 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find the magazine that teaches the Builder Tablet and its module. 0 = no spawn.
Chance to find the magazine that teaches the Master Tablet and its core. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootDiskProgr: Loot weight: Tablet install disk magazine
Chance to find the magazine that teaches how to program the Tablet install disk. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_DebugMode_too: Enables extra console logging for the Tablet add-on only. No gameplay effect.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootInstallDi: Multiplier for how often the already-programmed Tablet install disk spawns as loot in the world (separate from its blank/programmable counterpart). 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootManualAnt: Multiplier for how often the advanced antenna manual (teaches Tier 2/3 upgrades) spawns as loot. 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only... but this IS the book, so 0 makes the Tier 2/3 upgrade path find-only via other players/trade).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaCh: Multiplier for how often any of the 3 WiFi Chip tiers spawn as loot in the world. 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaT2: Multiplier for how often an already-upgraded Tier 2 antenna spawns as loot in the world. 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Tablet_LootAntennaT3: Multiplier for how often an already-upgraded Tier 3 (top) antenna spawns as loot in the world. 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
